prose: Professional consciousness rippler and bass player extraordinaire, Jorge Mesa of Third Eye Edify joins us tonight for a chill hangout: we both had new children born a week ago, so we'll swap some cool stories about the births, dad-life, and who knows, maybe some Halloween/Samhain gravy too. It'll be a fun way for me to ease back into the live stream biz after taking a few weeks break.
